literal_values.qualification: MIGHT HAVE BACKGROUND NOISE WHICH WOULD BE HELPFUL TO INVESTIGATION

observations.distinction: This is an intake report, not a recovered recording, cellular-tech finding, authenticated caller/aircraft or verified background-noise result. Recipient/source identity not supplied or reconstructed.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original submitted tip/source-contact record, message/device/copy and custody, carrier/event/caller attribution, positive/negative/inconclusive analytical result.

literal_values.directive_excerpt: AND OBTAIN RECORDING OF MESSAGE LEFT BY PASSENGER OF FLIGHT #77. MAY HAVE BACKGROUND NOISE.

observations.distinction: Unlike the previously read WF334 request concerning message contents, this unit explicitly requests obtaining a recording. Assignment/request is not completed contact, collection, authenticated media, analysis or disposition.
observations.missing_discriminator: Actual lead response/completion/disposition, contact/interview, media acquisition receipt/inventory, transfers/copies/examination and final result.

pins.field: Header Date / Information Received / Event Date-Time

observations.distinction: AM versus PM remains separately attributed to unjoined ICF records. Receipt/header/assignment labels are not a message-left time, calibrated clock or common event chronology. No time correction, delay/post-crash call calculation or common-record assumption.
observations.missing_discriminator: Native intake creation/edit/import history, original submission and receipt, routing/assignment/delivery logs and relevant event/carrier/device clock metadata.

pins.field: Synopsis / Control Number / Method / Source / Case / handwritten bottom notation

observations.distinction: Handwritten notation is a qualified reading; author/date/function and alias relationship unknown. Pending is a source label, not present case status. Source/method labels do not authenticate a submitted tip or establish who authored it. No network-address or masked-identity field published.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original intake/source record, native identifier/cross-reference map, version/routing and authority record; no assumption controls are replacements, aliases or independent calls.
